process.source: four_side_1024.v3.config (process imported from fslw.config by the frozen V3 config module)

z_model.note: model heights; no z transition implemented

propagation_loss.optical_loss_scope: propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated
propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated

definitions.straight: no arcs; all straight primitives collinear (single straight run)
definitions.short_S: exactly one historical short-S pair (two reverse theta arcs, theta=acos(1-d/(2R))) and no quarter arcs
definitions.L: exactly one quarter arc (90 deg) plus straight primitives
definitions.U: one net 180-degree turn inside the board: 'wide_U' (two quarter arcs with straight primitives between), 'hairpin' (two consecutive quarter arcs, no straight between), or 'hairpin_short_S' (SAME_HAIRPIN_A/B: one hairpin plus one historical short-S lateral shift, still a single 180-degree same-side U path)
definitions.multi_bend_refold: more than two effective bends: three or more quarter arcs, two or more hairpins, or a short-S combined with additional quarter arcs (folded/refold path)
definitions.other: anything that does not match the families above; in V3 this is the two-quarter step transfer (two quarter arcs with opposite sweeps, net turn 0 deg, the FSLW opposite-side 'U' transfer family), kept as 'other' because the required taxonomy has no step class and 'U' is reserved for net-180-degree U/hairpin paths

z1.definition: same-side 180-degree U/hairpin routes only (relation=='same' AND shape=='U' from saved primitives: wide_U, hairpin, and hairpin_short_S families); depth = inward distance from the shared board edge to the deepest point/track; track_count = number of straight segments parallel to the shared edge with length >= 0.5 mm (0 for pure hairpin-family paths that contain no straight track)

nesting.definition: an inner U nests in an outer U when its along-edge interval is contained in the outer interval and its track is deeper (larger depth from the shared edge)

adjacent_spacing.definition: consecutive U tracks per side with overlapping along-edge intervals; gap = exact minimum centreline distance between the two routes

bundles.definition: overlapping U intervals within one depth tolerance band (2 x clearance) form one bundle/arch track group

z2.definition: same-side 180-degree U/hairpin routes only (relation=='same' AND shape=='U' from saved primitives: wide_U, hairpin, and hairpin_short_S families); depth = inward distance from the shared board edge to the deepest point/track; track_count = number of straight segments parallel to the shared edge with length >= 0.5 mm (0 for pure hairpin-family paths that contain no straight track)

nesting.definition: an inner U nests in an outer U when its along-edge interval is contained in the outer interval and its track is deeper (larger depth from the shared edge)

adjacent_spacing.definition: consecutive U tracks per side with overlapping along-edge intervals; gap = exact minimum centreline distance between the two routes

bundles.definition: overlapping U intervals within one depth tolerance band (2 x clearance) form one bundle/arch track group

u_statistics.note: U/refold geometry statistics are per plane; the two heights are independent 2D problems, so nesting is reported per plane

z1.definition: refold = path shapes classified multi_bend_refold from primitives; congestion = refold-only centreline length per 5 x 5 mm cell (mm per cell)

z2.definition: refold = path shapes classified multi_bend_refold from primitives; congestion = refold-only centreline length per 5 x 5 mm cell (mm per cell)

cross_plane.note: SPEC §2/§5: two different glass heights; no cross-plane same-layer conflict test exists

z1.optical_loss_scope: propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated

z2.optical_loss_scope: propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated

bend_loss.note: no femtosecond-laser-written glass bend-loss function is known; R=40 mm is a geometry constraint only, not a measured loss value

crossing_loss.note: single-layer crossing optical feasibility not confirmed; crossing count is a geometric metric only

z1.optical_loss_scope: propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated

z2.optical_loss_scope: propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated

legacy_polymer_estimate.note: the previous polymer bend-loss model may be quoted for comparison only, never as glass truth

cross_plane_projected_overlap.note: XY projection of the plane-z1 and plane-z2 centrelines.  Per SPEC §2 the two rows live at different glass heights; projected crossings/overlaps are NOT same-plane conflicts and are never counted as violations.
cross_plane_projected_overlap.port_projection_note: both heights use the same 1024 XY port coordinates, so per-port projection coincidences are guaranteed by the interface model and are classified separately from real projected crossings

failure_taxonomy.note: merged over both planes; raw no_candidate_generated vs no_legal_candidate taxonomy is authoritative (SPEC §8)

metric_sources.per_plane: planes/<A>/<z>/statistics.json (recomputed from primitives; audit_strict.json merged when fresh)
metric_sources.combined: merged from the two plane statistics; same-plane crossings summed; cross-plane projection is informational only
metric_sources.path_shapes: SAVED PRIMITIVES ONLY per plane, merged by class/pair

notes: combined layout = plane z1 (row 1) + plane z2 (row 2) at model heights 0.0/0.5; each plane mixes same/opposite/adjacent classes
each plane is an independent 2D problem at layer=0; the two heights are NOT a waveguide layer stack and no z-transition is implemented
cross-plane XY-projected overlaps are informational only and never violations (SPEC §2)
bend loss and crossing loss remain unknown_uncalibrated
U/nesting statistics are per-plane (2D problems); the combined block merges them without pretending they interact across heights
